title: Drag approved editorial work to publish
description:
As an editor, I want the remaining production board behavior to use canonical CMS contracts.

Feature: Drag approved editorial work to publish
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given an authorized editor and a publishable linked Story with satisfied editorial prerequisites
    When the editor drags work to the publication stage
    Then the protected publish workflow records its result and a failed or forbidden action does not falsely show published content

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.
